hours.note: Three different answers exist in the source. The 09:00-17:00 value is the Rank Math opening-hours setting, identical for all seven days, which reads like an untouched default; the Contact page claims 24/7; the transfer booking engine accepts any pickup time. Confirm with the operator before publishing openingHours in schema.

found.tradingName: wp_options blogname ("Way to Crete - Crete Storytelling Tours - waytocrete.com") and the GDPR page (WP 2745), which refers to "the company under the title 'Way to Crete'".
found.mhte: Elementor footer template "way Footer" (WP 111) and its German twin (WP 2752): an image-box widget whose description_text is the bare string "1041E60000439401", sitting beside badge image /wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-6-1-1.png. The footer prints the number with no label, so the classification as an MHTE/GNTO tour-operator registry number rests on the format (NNNN + E + 11 digits), which is the Greek MHTE pattern. Verify with the operator before publishing it as a licence number.
